title: 第13章 分头行动谨慎行事第14章 太岁头上动土
content_zh:
;;
“二十两？”
林青心中一动。
这可不是小数目，足够普通人家一年的开销。
“师兄详细说说？”
“是内城一位姓柳的少爷委托的，这肉干算作给我的定金。”
张顺声音更低了：“码头那边，有个叫陈豹的白马帮头目，不长眼，抢了柳少爷看上的一个青楼头牌。”
“柳少爷气不过，又不好明面上动用家族力量，便私下找人，要给那黑心豹一个狠狠的教训。”
“什么教训？”林青开口。
“烧了他管着的那处堆放货物的货棚，让他吃个闷亏，破笔财。”
张顺顿了顿，道：“柳少爷说了，无论成与不成，这十两定钱先给了。”
“事成之后，若效果让他满意，另有酬谢。”
“我已经联系了馆里另外两个信得过的师弟，都是炼皮境，加上你我，四个人，足够稳妥。”
林青内心沉吟起来，若是白马帮其他头目的话，他估计也要掂量一二。
但那陈豹，本就不是什么好鸟。
他自然乐意给对方造成麻烦。
加之二十两银子，也确实不低了。
风险在于，在白马帮的地盘放火。
若是被当场抓住，后果不堪设想。
但张顺既然敢接，想必已有周详计划，而且还有另外两位师兄一起。

“好，既然师兄信得过我，这票我干了！”
林青最终下定决心。
既要习武，资源不可或缺。
这等机会，不容错过。
“痛快！”
张顺一拍大腿，将剩下肉干一并推给林青。
“师兄我最近需要钱，到时再结你余下的十五两。”
“没问题。”林青点头，收下肉干。
“明日戌时三刻，城东码头往西第三条巷子口集合，记得换身不起眼的衣服。”
“明白。”
结账时，林青抢先一步付了钱，动作自然。
张顺看在眼里，笑容更盛。
觉得这师弟越发顺眼。
人与人的交情，往往便是这样建立起来的。
离开酒楼，两人道别。
临离去前，张顺还拍了拍他的肩膀。
“阿青，我那在北境的兄弟来信了，说朝廷兵马大败。”
“你若信得过我，就提前做好屯粮的准备。”
张顺说罢，便也大步离去。
林青闻言，心中微凛。

难怪张顺要将肉干出手给自己。
content_en:
;;
"Twenty taels?"
Lin Qing's heart moved.
This is not a small amount, it is enough for an average family to spend for a year.
"Senior brother, can you tell me in detail?"
"It was commissioned by a young master named Liu in the inner city. This dried meat counts as a deposit for me."
Zhang Shun's voice became even lower: "Over there at the pier, there is a leader of the White Horse Gang named Chen Bao. He is not very discerning and robbed a top brothel that Master Liu was interested in."
"Young Master Liu was angry and couldn't use his family's power openly, so he secretly found someone to teach the black-hearted leopard a severe lesson."
"What lesson?" Lin Qing asked.
"Burn down the warehouse where goods are stored in his care, and let him suffer a lot and lose a lot of money."
Zhang Shun paused and said, "Master Liu said, no matter whether it succeeds or not, I will give you these ten taels of money first."
"After the work is completed, if the effect satisfies him, he will be rewarded."
"I have already contacted two other trustworthy junior brothers in the library, both of whom are in the Skin Refining Realm. Plus you and me, the four of us are safe enough."
Lin Qing pondered in his heart. If it were the other leaders of the White Horse Gang, he would probably have to weigh it.
But Chen Bao is not a good bird at all.
He is naturally happy to cause trouble to the other party.
In addition, twenty taels of silver is indeed not low.
The risk is setting fire to the White Horse Gang's territory.
If caught red-handed, the consequences would be disastrous.
But since Zhang Shun dared to take it, he must have had a detailed plan, and there were two other senior brothers with him.
"Okay, since senior brother can trust me, I will do this job!"
Lin Qing finally made up his mind.
In order to practice martial arts, resources are indispensable.
Don't miss this opportunity.
"Happy!"
Zhang Shun patted his thigh and pushed the remaining dried meat to Lin Qing.
"Senior brother, I need money recently. I will pay you the remaining fifteen taels when the time comes."
"No problem." Lin Qing nodded and accepted the dried meat.
"Tomorrow at 3:00, we will gather at the entrance of the third alley from the east pier to the west of the city. Remember to change into inconspicuous clothes."
"Understood."
When checking out, Lin Qing paid the money first and acted naturally.
Zhang Shun saw this and smiled even more.
I feel that this junior brother is becoming more and more pleasing to the eye.
Friendships between people are often established in this way.
After leaving the restaurant, the two said goodbye.
Before leaving, Zhang Shun patted him on the shoulder.
"Aqing, my brother in the north sent a letter, saying that the imperial army was defeated."
"If you can trust me, make preparations to collect food in advance."
After Zhang Shun finished speaking, he strode away.
Hearing this, Lin Qing felt slightly shocked.
No wonder Zhang Shun wanted to give the dried meat to himself.
